title: Library loan renewal cap
naturalLanguageRequirements: Patrons of a public library may renew a loan when no other patron is waiting. The source text does not say whether a loan may be renewed once or repeatedly.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Renew a loan

A patron renews a current loan when no other patron is waiting for the same item. The renewal limit is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Loan

The loan records the patron, the item, and the due date.

# Constraints

## Waiting patron

A loan is not renewed when another patron is waiting for the item.

unresolvedSlots.question: How many times may a patron renew a loan that has no waiting patron?

alternatives.label: A loan may be renewed at most once.
A loan may be renewed any number of times while no other patron is waiting.

unresolvedSlots.clarificationTarget: The maximum number of renewals for a loan with no waiting patron.
unresolvedSlots.stakeholderAnswer: A loan may be renewed at most once.
